description: Outstanding collateralised SFTR records (collateral_portfolio_code OR collateral_isin set) with no collateral_value reported (or zero, treated as not reported).
Outstanding SFTR TSR records with no loan_value reported (or zero, treated as not reported). SFTR mirror of DQI_VAL_MISSING.
SFTR TSR records whose state_as_of is older than the configured threshold (TARGET2 business days). Reuses the EMIR TimelinessThresholds.max_valuation_age_business_days config.
SFTR TAR records whose reporting_timestamp lags execution_timestamp by more than the configured max_reporting_delay_hours.
